nodes.label: D-11 DSC signing on desktop
nodes.rationale: Signing happens entirely inside Flourishive Desktop (pyHanko + PKCS#11); server only verifies and stores; key and PIN never leave signer's computer.

nodes.label: D-13 Three template paths
nodes.rationale: Visual editor, coded React-PDF layouts, HR uploads (PDF, fillable, DOCX). pdfmake part replaced by D-78.

nodes.label: D-14 DOCX to PDF route
nodes.rationale: Via Desktop or external conversion API, chosen per tenant by super admin; DOCX deferred by D-42.

nodes.label: D-24 Desktop pairing with API (P-01)
nodes.rationale: Desktop pairs with user account and talks to API directly; web opens it via flourishive:// link; no localhost server (avoids Chrome Private Network Access blocks and local HTTPS cert).

nodes.label: D-25 Organisation seal for OTP docs (P-02)
nodes.norm_label: d-25 organisation seal for otp docs (p-02)
nodes.rationale: OTP-accepted PDFs sealed server-side with organisation certificate so edits show as invalid.

nodes.label: D-28 Aadhaar eSign provider (P-05)
nodes.rationale: Compare 2-3 licensed providers in Phase 1, build against adapter, choose before Phase 2.

nodes.label: D-33 DSC flow re-confirmed
nodes.rationale: D-11 unchanged; server validates desktop-signed PDF before accepting.

nodes.label: D-35 Signatory is HR lead
nodes.rationale: HR lead is authorised signatory, mToken DSC in their name; configurable per entity.

nodes.label: D-39 Phase 2 build order
nodes.rationale: Foundations, workflow, OTP, verify, desktop pairing and DSC, letters/bulk, visual editor, eSign adapter; amended by D-75.

nodes.label: D-40 Tiptap editor
nodes.rationale: Tiptap for template Path A.

nodes.label: D-41 Self-signed organisation seal
nodes.rationale: Server seals OTP-accepted docs with self-signed cert plus RFC 3161 timestamp behind seal adapter; Adobe shows yellow signer unknown; green ticks come from DSC and Aadhaar eSign; purchased cert unsuited to shared hosting. Supersedes earlier no-seal choice.

nodes.label: D-42 DOCX Path C deferred
nodes.rationale: Plain and fillable PDF uploads only for now.

nodes.label: D-43 PDF engine split
nodes.rationale: React-PDF for coded layouts, pdf-lib for letterhead, QR and stamping; embedded Devanagari fonts.

nodes.label: D-44 Aadhaar eSign mock adapter
nodes.rationale: Adapter with mock provider only; real provider chosen later; mock outputs labelled TEST.

nodes.label: D-45 Device pairing
nodes.rationale: One-time 10-minute code plus flourishive:// link swaps for revocable signing-only credential; no password in desktop app.

nodes.label: D-46 Job delivery by polling
nodes.rationale: Desktop polls every 30s; web Sign now opens app by link; no WebSocket (poor fit for shared cPanel).

nodes.label: D-47 Seal and DSC together
nodes.rationale: Acceptance sealed immediately; DSC added after as incremental update; both stay valid.

nodes.label: D-49 Native Qt animation
nodes.rationale: Animation drawn in Qt driven by real state, web keeps React component, shared path definitions.

nodes.label: D-50 Signature stamp look
nodes.rationale: Visible designed stamp with green-tick emblem beside QR stamp; PDF is static so red cross appears in desktop, verify page, Adobe overlay.

nodes.label: D-51 First build without purchases
nodes.rationale: Unsigned Windows pilot build by CI; code signing, notarisation and auto-update wait for certificates.

nodes.label: D-52 Token testing with SoftHSM
nodes.rationale: Tested end to end with SoftHSM against real validator; real signing waits for renewed DSC or TEST switch.

nodes.label: D-72 Files on Cloudflare R2
nodes.rationale: Stored files move to private R2 bucket behind storage service; downloads redirect to 5-minute presigned link after permission checks so bytes bypass the server.

nodes.label: D-73 Uploads through API
nodes.rationale: API still checks content type and sha256 before writing to R2.

nodes.label: D-74 R2 migration
nodes.rationale: Re-runnable verified copy command, local read fallback, delete local after a week of zero fallbacks; rollback is one setting.

nodes.label: D-75 Phase 2 order amendment
nodes.rationale: Amends D-39: R2 is PR 8, visual editor PR 9, Aadhaar eSign adapter PR 10, before bulk issue creates many PDFs.

nodes.label: D-76 Bulk issue
nodes.rationale: Pick people or CSV, validate every row first, resumable queue job, 200 rows max.

nodes.label: D-77 Letter delivery and offer hold
nodes.norm_label: d-77 letter delivery and offer hold
nodes.rationale: HR-triggered email with private cancellable 30-day link; offer downloads locked until admin releases (documents.release), so candidates cannot shop offers; setting documents.holdOfferDownloads.

nodes.label: D-78 Editor PDF engine
nodes.rationale: Visual editor JSON drawn by React-PDF, sharing fonts, letterhead and stamping; replaces pdfmake in D-13.

nodes.label: D-32 Other Redis uses
nodes.rationale: Rate limits, lockouts, settings/permission cache, short-lived tokens; OTPs and evidence stay in MySQL.

nodes.label: D-53 Visual direction v2
nodes.rationale: Light-first mint and deep teal, Outfit headings, large radii; dark is green-black; supersedes D-08 colours.

nodes.label: D-55 Platform staff roles
nodes.rationale: Permission-based roles with presets Owner, Super admin, Support, Read-only auditor; always at least one active Owner.

nodes.label: D-56 Support access
nodes.rationale: Tenant data only via time-limited reasoned support sessions visible to tenant; read-only default.

nodes.label: D-57 Runtime config and secrets
nodes.rationale: Settings and keys in DB, secrets encrypted write-only with Test button and step-up; env fallback; bootstrap keys stay in api.env.

nodes.label: D-58 Email senders
nodes.rationale: Platform default; tenant may use own SMTP or verified From; activate only after code, test mail, SPF/DKIM/DMARC check.

nodes.label: D-59 Email templates
nodes.rationale: Per event subject/body with escaped allow-listed variables, preview, test, reset; no logic.

nodes.label: D-60 Mail delivery log
nodes.rationale: Every email recorded and resendable; OTP, reset and invite bodies never stored.

nodes.label: D-61 Tenant branding
nodes.rationale: Logos, favicon, sign-in panel, presets and custom accent with WCAG AA check, curated fonts, draft/preview/publish/revert.

nodes.label: D-62 Product brand in DB
nodes.rationale: Super admin edits brand, served by GET /v1/brand; brand.json only fallback.

nodes.label: D-63 Account actions
nodes.rationale: Reset password/two-step, unlock, sign out, suspend, resend invite, change email; reason, step-up, audit; tenant admins only on subset-permission users.

nodes.label: D-64 Two-step ease
nodes.rationale: Remember device, email code fallback, passkeys, separate admin session length.

nodes.label: D-66 Break-glass
nodes.rationale: Another Owner resets locked-out Owner, else server command platform-reset-mfa, audited.

nodes.label: D-67 Logs
nodes.rationale: Errors as plain-English story, requests, jobs/email, sign-ins; request IDs; MySQL with masking, 7-180 day retention; Sentry-compatible forwarding.

nodes.label: D-68 Alerts
nodes.rationale: Per-admin alert emails per event: instant, digest or off; off by default.

nodes.label: D-69 Company configuration
nodes.rationale: Region and formats, sign-in rules, notification rules, custom domains via Caddy on-demand TLS for verified domains.

nodes.label: D-70 Platform controls
nodes.rationale: Announcement banner, maintenance mode, per-tenant feature switches, usage overview, settings import/export without secrets.

nodes.label: D-71 Console UX
nodes.rationale: Grouped settings hub with search, hint, lock; setup wizard for new tenants.
